title: Yara and the Atlas
author: Tamsin Montrose
blurb: Jonah Galloway, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
